nodes.label: UzCasting UI/UX Technical Specification (base version)
nodes.rationale: The earliest of the four versions; its value is the technical requirements section on page 20. Each screen page states the visuals are a direction only and the final UI is made pixel-perfect in Figma.

nodes.label: 03 Registration / Login (phone or email)
nodes.rationale: Account creation by phone or email with Google/Apple/Telegram named as convenient entry options, plus password/PIN, language choice and consent to the privacy and usage terms - the clause used to justify not demanding a phone number after Google sign-in.

nodes.label: 05 Premiere Catalog (base)
nodes.rationale: Barchasi/Seriallar/Ko'rsatuvlar/Filmlar tabs with 5000 sum and Premium badges and genre/language filters.

nodes.label: 06 Serial / Episode Detail (base)
nodes.rationale: Locked episodes with an 'unlock episode 2 for 5000 sum' CTA that turns into Play once purchased.

nodes.label: 14 Creator Dashboard and 16 50/50 Monetization (base)
nodes.rationale: Gross sales, platform share, creator share, refunds and adjustments, available balance and withdrawal request - the first place refunds are mentioned without any rules attached.

nodes.label: 17 Settings (base)
nodes.rationale: UZ/RU/EN language, notifications, security, payment methods, privacy, terms and account deletion.

nodes.label: 19 Technical Requirements (base p.20)
nodes.rationale: Secure OTP authentication, role-based access for User/Creator/Admin, video access control so a locked episode cannot be opened, payment webhook and transaction verification, purchase history with refund status, push notifications, search and filters, scalable media storage/CDN, error logging and analytics, admin moderation, API documentation, and handing source code plus deployment credentials to the client.

nodes.label: 20 Business Model (base)
nodes.rationale: The creator posts episode 1 free on Instagram/YouTube and directs viewers to UzCasting to watch the continuation before anyone else for 5000 sum, taking a revenue share.

nodes.label: 21 Design Direction (base)
nodes.rationale: Premium dark UI in deep black/navy with neon purple, magenta, electric blue and gold accents, rounded cards, cinematic imagery, soft glow and strong typography.

nodes.label: 22 Figma Is the Final Source of Truth (base)
nodes.rationale: The PDF is explicitly only a UX/UI direction; the real screens, user flow, API contract and database schema are produced in Figma, and development starts after approval.

nodes.label: ChatGPT as Product/Design Copilot
nodes.rationale: Stated in every spec version: the assistant produces concept, UX/UI direction, screen logic, user flow, monetization and microcopy, while final code, architecture, security, payment integration, legal documents and store compliance stay with the developer team.
